references.title: DWDS: erinnern
references.supports: The Wortzerlegung er-, with no headword for the rest; ⟨sich an etw., jmdn. erinnern⟩ is sense 1a; Etymologie: the prefix formation, like mhd. innern, belongs to the comparative ahd. innaro 'inner'

references.title: DWDS: inner
references.supports: inner is an Adjektiv (nur attributiv, ohne Komparativ)

references.title: en.wiktionary: erinnern
references.supports: From Middle High German erinnern, from er- + innern, from Old High German innarōn, from innar 'inner'

notes.rationale: The reflexive is a satellite, read from lexicallyReflexive, so the Breakdown spells the word erinnern, not the Canonical Form sich erinnern (ADR 0050; judges agreed on #1241, 2026-10-25). No headword innern exists, so the base is the word DWDS and en.wiktionary trace it to, ADJ inner, with the citation ending n as filler, as in verarzten = ver- + Arzt + en.
